item.title: 🌿 Transcending Death Through Art: Rumi’s “Any Soul That Drank the Nectar” Reimagined as NFT.
item.description:
In a world saturated with fleeting visuals, true art whispers to the soul. Our latest NFT release, inspired by Mewlana Jalaluddin Rumi’s mystical poem “Any Soul That Drank the Nectar,” invites collectors into a realm where passion defies mortality and fragrance outlives flesh.

✨ The Poem That Breathed Life Into Pixels

“Death came, smelled me, and sensed your fragrance instead. From then on, death lost all hope of me.” — Rumi
